svg.text: The Big Picture — Kubernetes: a school that runs itself · 26 lessons, one campus
☸️ THE CORE SCHOOL (lessons 1–13)
🪑 desks & monitors (L1–4)
containers 🍱 ride in pods (desks) · the class monitor
keeps N alive, always · reception ☎️ gives pods one
stable number — kids move, the number doesn't
🚪 rooms & settings (L5–8)
namespaces = classrooms · notice board 📌 vs locker
key 🔑 (config vs secrets) · two probe questions 🙋 ·
lunch portions: requests reserve, limits cap 🍛
🚌 traffic & change (L9–12)
HPA: extra buses on rainy days · one gate + signboard
(ingress) 🏫 · substitutions mid-game = zero-downtime
rollouts ⚽ · backpack vs library shelf (storage) 📚
🏢 the office (L13)
principal (API server) · register
(etcd) 📖 · timetable-maker ·
class teachers (kubelet)
💡 the ONE idea, thirteen costumes: declare a wish → a monitor reconciles reality toward it, forever
Deployment wishes for pods · HPA wishes for a CPU% · the office stores every wish in the register — and everything in Part 3
(and ArgoCD, one school over) is the same loop wearing a new hat · real manifests for all of it live in this repo's k8s/ folder
then the campus grows up: robots deploy it, buildings multiply, and you learn to run it at 3 AM 🌙
🧰 SHIP IT & RUN IT FOR REAL (lessons 14–26)
🤖 ship & survive (L14–15)
GitOps: the caretaker robot reads the plan book —
deploys = commits, rollback = git revert ⏪ ·
multi-AZ: never seat the whole class in one building 🏫🏫 ·
the scaling ladder: more pods → more desks → more
buildings · PDB: never everyone at lunch at once 🍽️
🩺 operate (L16–21)
the nurse's triage chart: Pending, ImagePull, CrashLoop,
OOMKilled — describe → events → logs, always · hall
passes (RBAC) 🪪 · homework & the bell (Jobs/CronJobs
+ the real backup!) ⏰ · passing-notes rules (NetworkPolicies)
🚫📝 · assigned seating (taints) 🎫 · one 🧯 per floor
🏗️ advanced ops (L22–26)
desks with name plates (StatefulSets) 🏷️ · who leaves
when lunch runs short (QoS/evictions) 🍽️ · renovating
while school stays open (upgrades: cordon→drain) ·
teaching the office new words (CRDs/operators) 🤖 ·
report cards, diaries, alarm bells (observability) 📈
🎓 the flagship school: 26 lessons · 26 branches · real manifests, real Terraform, real CI — plus its own 9-week study plan
under the cluster: EC2 desks, IAM hats, the VPC campus (see the AWS-components map on the site) ·
siblings supply the rest: Docker packs 🍱 · ArgoCD deploys 🤖 · AWS explains the ground it stands on 🪪
